proof:
have h₁ : ∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t := by
  intro x t
  constructor
  · ext i
    simp [base, join]
  · simp [height, join]
have h₂ : ∀ z : V (n+1), join (base z) (height z) = z := by
  intro z
  ext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp [join, height]
  · simp [join, base]
refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, h₁, h₂, ?_⟩
· intro p q h
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hb := congrArg base h
    simpa only [(h₁ p.1 p.2).1, (h₁ q.1 q.2).1] using hb
  · have ht := congrArg height h
    simpa only [(h₁ p.1 p.2).2, (h₁ q.1 q.2).2] using ht
· intro z
  exact ⟨(base z, height z), h₂ z⟩
· intro x y t u
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [join]
statement: Function.Bijective (fun p : V n × ℝ => join p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t) ∧ (∀ z : V (n+1), join (base z) (height z) = z) ∧ (∀ (x y : V n) (t u : ℝ), dist (join x t) (join y u) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 + dist t u ^ 2)
